title: Associate a key with each map element
body:
I'm trying to do this: ``` jsx import React from 'react' import {RefinementList} from 'react-instantsearch' function CustomRefinementList (props) { return ( {props.items.length &&
{props.title}
} ) } export default RefinementList.connect(CustomRefinementLis ``` It doesn't work because it's in a infinite rendering loop. Because `RefinementList` and `List` element are generated dynamically, I think that the problem is because is necessary associate a `key` (related: https://facebook.github.io/react/docs/multiple-components.html#dynamic-children)

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @Morhaus, @mthuret and @vvo to be potential reviewers

Hi, thanks a lot!

We did not think of that use case indeed, what you would need to use here is the unconnected component (RefinementList) I guess. We do not expose it today.

I am not comfortable with your patch right now, I feel like we are patching something that is not meant to be used this way. I guess we could just expose the non-connected components for you to reuse like you just did.

What do you think?

@Kikobeats We are not yet sure on the best way on how to do that and so will hold on this feature for now. You can definitely reimplement your own RefinementList instead of tryin to reuse the `<RefinementList/>` here by using the connector API.

Sorry this is not the best solution we think right now but we don't want to go too fast and keep some space for API additions by getting more feedback and ideas. Thanks a lot for contribution though.

Sure, I understand. Just need a fancy way to access to https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/v2/packages/react-instantsearch/src/components/RefinementList.js#L4-L9 for do the same but out of the library. 

I know that styles are exposed under `defaultClassNames`, but exists a way to import the rest?

That's very hacky eheh indeed since none of those are official API entries and might just be removed.

I would go for reimplementing your own small refinement list, since it should be less code than what you did.

I understand that we are not very explicit on the default widgets goals. Basically as soon as you hit a feature wall (can't do X), you need to use connectors.

The Panel question is currently a pain we need to solve
